study: partial-stroke finite-strain J2 forming and springback
comparison_limitations: This run uses frictionless isotropic J2 plane strain and reaches only 48.195 mm of the 70 mm reference stroke.
The reference uses Hill48 anisotropy, nonzero friction, and shell elements. The angle difference is therefore not a same-condition benchmark comparison.

support_branch_end_evidence.interpretation: The next requested state has no holder support row inside the contact tolerance; at the preceding smaller stroke the nearest row is within tolerance but its KKT multiplier becomes tensile.

tool_geometry_diagnostic.reference_holder_inner_corner: The source profile has a sharp line-line corner at local (x,z)=(31.0, 0.39) mm.
tool_geometry_diagnostic.run_holder_corner_treatment: The forming driver replaces that corner with an added 0.6 mm circular fillet.
tool_geometry_diagnostic.interpretation: The force-controlling holder reaction is carried by the added fillet at the source profile's inner edge, so this partial-stroke branch depends on non-reference geometry.

sharp_corner_re_equilibration.method: Temporary driver copy with the added fillet disabled; re-equilibrated the saved displacement and J2 history at the same stroke after rebuilding contact multipliers.
sharp_corner_re_equilibration.result: Contact active-set solve failed before accepting the re-equilibrated state.
sharp_corner_re_equilibration.interpretation: Removing the added fillet does not immediately recover a nearby force-support branch; exact-corner contact or a physically justified holder model is still needed.

parameter_checks.tight_equilibrium_result: No load-controlled increment was accepted at the 0.175 N/mm effective equilibrium tolerance.
parameter_checks.result: The same contact support transition remained; reducing the trust limits did not resolve it.
parameter_checks.microincrement_result: The same holder row became tensile and no stroke increment was accepted.
parameter_checks.holder_position_diagonal_regularization: Temporarily regularizing the holder Newton direction after support release did not produce an accepted increment; this trial-only modification was removed.
parameter_checks.holder_collocation_32_points_per_facet: Repeated support transfer with a 4.627e3 N/mm multiplier; no increment accepted.
parameter_checks.holder_collocation_64_points_per_facet: Contact solve did not accept an increment within the observation window.
parameter_checks.punch_die_collocation_8_points_per_facet: Contact KKT solve became singular; no increment accepted.
parameter_checks.holder_seed_tensile_release_threshold_10: The support multiplier rose to about 62 N/mm tensile and the increment remained unaccepted.
The near-contact seed was retained longer, but the solver returned to the open neighboring seed; no increment was accepted.
